import unittest

from solution import make_grid, reshape, set_cell


class GridTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_make_grid_rows_and_cells_do_not_alias(self):
        fill = {"items": []}
        grid = make_grid(2, 3, fill)
        self.assertEqual(grid, [[fill, fill, fill], [fill, fill, fill]])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0], grid[1])
        for r in range(2):
            for c in range(3):
                self.assertIsNot(grid[r][c], fill)
        grid[0][0]["items"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(fill, {"items": []})
        for r in range(2):
            for c in range(3):
                if (r, c) != (0, 0):
                    self.assertEqual(grid[r][c], {"items": []})

    def test_zero_dimensions(self):
        self.assertEqual(make_grid(0, 4), [])
        grid = make_grid(3, 0)
        self.assertEqual(grid, [[], [], []])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0], grid[1])
        self.assertEqual(reshape([], 0, 5), [])
        reshaped = reshape([], 2, 0)
        self.assertEqual(reshaped, [[], []])
        self.assertIsNot(reshaped[0], reshaped[1])

    def test_reshape_deep_copies_each_value(self):
        shared = [1]
        values = [shared, shared, {"x": [2]}, 4]
        grid = reshape(values, 2, 2)
        self.assertEqual(grid, [[[1], [1]], [{"x": [2]}, 4]])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0][0], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0][1], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0][0], grid[0][1])
        grid[0][0].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(shared, [1])
        self.assertEqual(grid[0][1], [1])

    def test_set_cell_mutates_only_selected_cell_and_copies_value(self):
        grid = make_grid(2, 2, {"old": []})
        untouched = grid[1][1]
        value = {"new": []}
        returned = set_cell(grid, 0, 1, value)
        self.assertIs(returned, grid)
        self.assertEqual(grid[0][1], value)
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0][1], value)
        self.assertIs(grid[1][1], untouched)
        value["new"].append(1)
        self.assertEqual(grid[0][1], {"new": []})

    def test_dimensions_and_value_count_validation(self):
        for dimensions in ((True, 1), (1, False), (1.0, 1), (1, "2"), (-1, 1), (1, -1)):
            with self.subTest(dimensions=dimensions):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    make_grid(*dimensions)
        for values in ("abc", b"abc", 3, None):
            with self.subTest(values=values):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    reshape(values, 1, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            reshape([1, 2, 3], 2, 2)

    def test_set_cell_validation_and_boundaries(self):
        for grid in (None, (), [1], [[1], [1, 2]]):
            with self.subTest(grid=grid):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    set_cell(grid, 0, 0, 1)
        grid = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
        for row, column in ((-1, 0), (0, -1), (2, 0), (0, 2)):
            with self.subTest(row=row, column=column):
                with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
                    set_cell(grid, row, column, 0)
        for row, column in ((True, 0), (0, False), (0.0, 0), (0, "0")):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                set_cell(grid, row, column, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            set_cell([], 0, 0, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            set_cell([[]], 0, 0, 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
